description: Pre-existing broken heading anchors inside docs/**/*.md, recorded so the link/anchor gate can be strict about everything else. scripts/ci/check-doc-links.py reports each of these as a warning instead of an error. The list is a ratchet, not a parking lot: an entry that no longer matches a real break is an ERROR, so it can only shrink. Do not add to it — fix the link instead.
